fusions.name: Running Scales
fusions.desc: Sends a click of sound into the first enemy in its path for 4 resonating damage, with a 40% chance to add an instance of [Vibrant Echo] for 6 seconds. Each instance on the target adds to the damage of the rest.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Bite
fusions.desc: A bite on an enemy at or below 20% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. It deals 22 damage, consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Second Pass
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting, and jinks you 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Lessons in Evasion
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 3% more damage per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
